title: E2AP: use VAL_PTR in shortName decoding
description: Store the ran function shortName in a `VAL_PTR` rather than trying to guess where it begins when we perform string comparisons with the ran function mappings that we support. This fixes issue #19036 by using the new `VAL_PTR` options for ASN1 per_PRINTABLE_STRING introduced by !10473
